| `interfaceType` | One of `"svi" | "ethernet" | "loopback" | "port-channel"`. |

3. Which interface type and information type you’re interested in.

If you can supply those details (or if you have a different API endpoint that returns node lists), I’ll be happy to help you construct the correct call.
